script:
control-agent-server api GET "<redacted:session-cookie>/$A" --quiet --check stats.usage_to_metrics.default.accumulated_cost gt 0
FK=$(control-agent-server api POST "<redacted:session-cookie>/$A/fork" --json '{"reset_metrics": false}' --expect 201 --quiet \
  --check stats.usage_to_metrics.default.accumulated_cost gt 0 --save F10.fork-metrics/kept --field id)
control-agent-server api GET "<redacted:session-cookie>/$FK" --quiet --check stats.usage_to_metrics.default.accumulated_cost gt 0
FR=$(control-agent-server api POST "<redacted:session-cookie>/$A/fork" --expect 201 --quiet \
  --check stats.usage_to_metrics len-eq 0 --save F10.fork-metrics/reset --field id)
control-agent-server api GET "<redacted:session-cookie>/$FR" --quiet --check stats.usage_to_metrics len-eq 0
